messages:
anya: quick sync / manifest-level provenance + hotstart hints: where do we put them? weightsource or runtime?
marco: weightsource. centralizes metadata and signing. runtime consumes canonical manifest.
lee: agree but runtime needs small validation controls (fast vs full). add a capability flag on request.
sam: propose fields: canonical_order, hot_windows (byte ranges), eviction_group, provenance_signatures. runtime can ask for 'fast-warmup' to get compact hot_windows only.
oliver: example manifest snippet: ```{
  "format": "safetensors-split",
  "blobs": ["s3://m/foo/0","s3://m/foo/1"],
  "checksums": ["sha256:aaa","sha256:bbb"],
  "canonical_order": true,
  "hot_windows": [[0,131072],[0,131072]],
  "eviction_group": "g-12",
  "provenance_signatures": ["ed25519:sig..."]
}```
anya: +1. need error semantics too: 4xx manifest/compat no retry, 5xx transport retry/backoff.
marco: security: weightsource should advertise sig_alg and we enforce allowed algos in runtime. no arbitrary picks.
lee: runtime pre-validate: fetch first 4KB (or hot_windows prefix), verify checksum, then mmap. reduces silent failures.
sam: fallback: if weightsource offers streaming endpoint, runtime can stream for cold starts if gating=fast-warmup. we should standardize fallback_endpoints field.
ci-bot: perf note: offloading negotiation to weightsource in last canary reduced median load by ~0.7ms; streaming fallback cut 95p cold by ~100ms.
anya: action items: marco spec manifest+sig fields, lee spec pre-validate, sam wire eviction_group into scheduler, oliver mock fallback. i'll open follow-up RFC and link.
marco: will start PR for manifest v2 shim.
lee: will draft runtime pre-validate patch.
ci-bot: reminder: tag PR with eng-ml/warmup for perf collection.
